title: I made a multiplayer banger racing game where the entire objective is to get onto the back of a moving truck
author: Material_Poem_9438
selftext:
I’ve been building a small multiplayer browser game called **Trailer Rush**.

You get 60 seconds to chase down a transporter, line yourself up with the rear ramp and get onto the trailer before the timer hits zero.

The problem is you’re racing against other players trying to do exactly the same thing. There’s barely enough room on the trailer, everyone can ram each other, block the ramp and knock each other straight back onto the track.

There are no weapons — your car is the weapon. Get on, stay on, and make sure you’re still aboard when the clock runs out.

It runs directly in the browser, with no account or download needed.

Would be interested to know whether the idea actually looks fun to people who haven’t spent hours staring at it 😅
